A second model for the same matches. Each team has a rating at home and another away; after every match both sides' ratings move by how much it surprised, counting 25% of the goal difference and 75% of the xG difference. Tested on the rounds already played of the 2026 Série A and Série B, the two models were equally wrong, and the average of the two a little less, a gap small enough to be chance. The chances in the table above still come from the simulator's model alone.
